name: Breeze Canna Disposable Live Resin | Kush Mints
description: Refresh your senses with Kush Mints' invigorating blend of cool mint and classic kush earthiness. Featuring beta caryophyllene, limonene, and linalool terpenes, this balanced hybrid delivers smooth, uplifting effects perfect for creative endeavors and social gatherings while maintaining that signature kush backbone.
